# Preface {.unnumbered}

These are my personal notes compiled while studying probability and statistics
at university. They combine the mathematical development of the material with
worked examples and simulations in R.

The source for these notes lives on
[GitHub](https://github.com/yourusername/stats-notes).

## How these notes are organized

- **Probability** — foundational definitions, random variables, and standard
  distributions.
- **Statistical inference** — estimation, hypothesis testing, and confidence
  intervals.
- **Regression & modeling** — linear models and beyond.

Each chapter mixes theory (definitions, theorems, derivations) with R code
used to illustrate or verify the results.
